q: Environment is everything that is around us. It can be living (biotic) or non-living (______).
e: Environment is everything that is around us. It can be living (biotic) or non-living (abiotic). Abiotic factors are the non-living parts of the environment. Aquatic is not abiotic.

q: The four major components of the environment together are known as the ______.
e: The four major components of the environment together are known as the ecosphere. The ecosphere is hydrosphere, lithosphere, atmosphere, and biosphere together. The environment is classified into four major components that make the ecosphere. Biosphere is different: the biosphere is the global life layer where living things exist.

q: The hydrosphere includes all ______ such as lakes, ponds, rivers, streams, and oceans.
e: The hydrosphere includes all water bodies such as lakes, ponds, rivers, streams, and oceans. The hydrosphere is all water bodies: lakes, rivers, seas, and oceans. Gaseous layers is not water bodies.

q: Lithosphere mainly contains soil, earth rocks, mountains, etc., and is divided into three layers: crust, mantle, and ______.
e: Lithosphere mainly contains soil, earth rocks, mountains, etc., and is divided into three layers: crust, mantle, and core. The lithosphere is the rock and soil crust of the earth. Rocks and soil belong to the lithosphere. Exosphere is different: the exosphere is the outermost fringe of atmosphere, not the life layer.

q: The cover of air that envelopes the Earth is known as the ______.
e: The cover of air that envelopes the Earth is known as the atmosphere. The atmosphere is the layer of gases around the earth. Hydrosphere is different: the hydrosphere is all water bodies: lakes, rivers, seas, and oceans.

q: The biosphere is otherwise known as the ______.
e: The biosphere is otherwise known as the life layer. The life layer is the biosphere, where living things actually exist. The biosphere is the global life layer where living things exist. Rock layer is not life layer.

q: An ecosystem is a functional unit of nature where living organisms interact among themselves and also with the surrounding ______.
e: An ecosystem is a functional unit of nature where living organisms interact among themselves and also with the surrounding physical environment. The environment is everything around an organism, biotic and abiotic. Biological molecules occur naturally inside living organisms, not in bare rock. Solar radiation is not physical environment.

q: Which of the following is NOT listed as a terrestrial ecosystem in the textbook?
e: Coral reef NOT listed as a terrestrial ecosystem in the textbook? Coral reefs are highly productive marine ecosystems built by coral animals and algae. An ecosystem is a community plus its physical environment, linked by energy and materials. Grassland is not coral reef.

q: Freshwater ecosystems comprise about ______ of the Earth's surface.
e: Freshwater ecosystems comprise about 1.8% of the Earth's surface. 71% is not 1.8%.

q: Marine ecosystems are the ______ ecosystem of the Earth.
e: Marine ecosystems are the largest ecosystem of the Earth. An ecosystem is a community plus its physical environment, linked by energy and materials. Most polluted is not largest.
